messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up — StratoIQ dedicated pool activation is next Tue 09:00 PST. Need final quota sign-off, autoscale run window, and enablement invite for their platform team.

Ethan (Infra): Can we move the active load window to 13:00 PST instead? Host-level GPU maintenance is scheduled earlier. Also want to confirm priming strategy (tokens + prefix cache).

Priya (Success Eng): 13:00 works for us. Proposed warmup: 30m sustained baseline + 3 x 2m spike bursts. Baseline: 100 rps, spikes to 400 rps. We'll validate prefix caching and KV warmup.

Noah (ML Eng): Model details: stratoiq-v2 (q4_0) — estimate 7.6 ms/token on p4d at bs=8. For safety set batch_size=8, max_seq=1024. If we see >85% GPU mem, auto-scale threshold should add one node.

Aisha (CSM): Customer asks for SLA confirmation and KMS check. Priya — can you run through SSO + KMS items during enablement? I’ll loop in their infra lead. @Ethan will you confirm failover route if dedicated pool OOMs?

Ethan (Infra): Failover plan: route to hosted-small variant (stratoiq-v2-slim) with degraded latency but preserved availability. Autoscale policy:
```
policy: util_percent
threshold: 85
scale_step: +1
cooldown: 120s
fallback: hosted-small
```
I'll also enable prefix/KV cache prepopulate.

Priya (Success Eng): Enablement invite sent to StratoIQ infra + devs for tomorrow 10:00 PST. Agenda: SSO, KMS, runbook, access to logs + cost dashboard.

Aisha (CSM): Risk callout for renewal: flag if p95 latency > 400ms or error rate > 1% during the smoke. Let's capture perf + qualitative feedback in the 24h post-run.

Ethan (Infra): I'll execute the shadow load at 13:05 and then the official load at 13:15. Command I'm using (local run):
```
./loadgen --target 100 --duration 1800 --burst 400 --model stratoiq-v2 --prefix-cache=true
```
Will post Prometheus and flamegraphs here after completion.

deploy-bot: Reminder — infra maintenance window 2026-04-12 06:00-08:00 UTC (affects eu-west nodes).

Noah (ML Eng): Quick perf tip: disable mixed-precision rollover for this run to get stable memory footprint. Also capture KV hit rate.

Priya (Success Eng): Smoke checklist we're validating:
- Quota: 12k tokens/min reserved
- Warmup: prefix/KV seeded
- Autoscale: threshold = 85% GPU util
- Fallbacks: hosted-small route tested
- KMS: customer key verified
- Observability: retention 7d for this account

Aisha (CSM): Thanks team. I'll own post-run feedback collection and send the renewal health note if anything looks risky. ETA for results?

Ethan (Infra): Results posted ~13:45 PST. Prom dashboards: https://prom.example.com/stratoiq/run/1768400025 (will upload flamegraphs and a short summary).

Priya (Success Eng): I'll follow up with StratoIQ to capture their runbook feedback and any enablement gaps.

Aisha (CSM): Perfect. Tagging this as the final pre-activation thread. :thumbsup:
